text: WELL has a "high" Earnings Quality Ranking (EQR) for the 1st week. Earnings quality refers to the extent to which current earnings predict future earnings. "High-quality" earnings are expected to persist, while "low-quality" earnings do not. EQR is a weekly ranking of relative earnings quality for a large universe of publicly traded US equities. Companies are compared to peers in their industry. Find out more about EQR data.

scoring_method.confidence_method: LOW for every ranked equity because only 2 of 4 factor families are available/supportive
scoring_method.kelly_method: beta-adjusted residual edge (mu - beta*SPY_mu) divided by tracking-error variance; 0.25x Kelly capped at 5%
scoring_method.macro_polarity: NEUTRAL defensive rotation: lower beta/vol and shallower drawdown score better
scoring_method.risk_standard_deviation: population standard deviation (ddof=0), scaled by sqrt(21)
scoring_method.volatility_penalty: -0.05 when 30d realized volatility exceeds 2x the median of the same GICS sector; medians computed across 514 scored equities
